wiki.title: Brandy Fluker-Reid
wiki.extract: Brandy Fluker-Reid (née Fluker Oakley) is an American politician serving as the State Representative for Massachusetts' 12th Suffolk State House district since 2021. Her district includes part of Milton in Norfolk County, as well as the Boston neighborhoods of Dorchester, Hyde Park, Mattapan and Roslindale in Suffolk county. She is a member of the Democratic Party.
